title: Gerente de Planejamento e Produto
description: Job description O Gerente de Planejamento Comercial e Produto é o guardião do ciclo completo do produto na companhia. Este profissional atua de forma híbrida e estratégica: orienta a construção de coleções altamente assertivas (Sell In) cruzando dados históricos e tendências de mercado, ao mesmo tempo em que garante o sucesso da execução e o giro do produto no ponto de venda (Sell Out). É o elo que conecta o resultado comercial, o planejamento de estoque e a execução de Visual Merchandising (VM) multicanal. Main responsibilities Estratégia de Produto & Ciclo de Desenvolvimento (Sell In): Direcionamento de Mix: Definir o mix de produtos por canal e cluster, assegurando a total coerência entre o sortimento planejado, a pirâmide de preço e a meta comercial da marca. Gestão de Portfólio (Riscos e Oportunidades): Identificar gaps de categorias/subcategorias e faixas de preço; avaliar a concorrência e mapear produtos com alto potencial de escala ou riscos de baixa performance (bestsellers vs. slow movers). Tendências e Mercado: Monitorar continuamente o mercado exterior e referências internacionais para trazer inputs estratégicos para o desenvolvimento das coleções. Value Generation: Partner closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to develop scalable digital activations and integrations that deliver measurable value to fans and partners alike. Tournament Planning & Delivery: Become an integral enabler of tournament‑time digital operations, delivering high‑traffic match moments, live content publishing, rapid issue resolution and cross‑functional coordination during competition periods. Collaboration: Operate as an integral member of Digital Delivery, working alongside Product Managers located across Europe and acting as the department’s key representative within FIFA27. Governance & Communication: Provide clear, consistent updates to senior management and key stakeholders. Participation in cross‑functional steering groups to maintain a balance between critical tournament milestones and product scope delivery. Drive Innovation: Champion a consumer‑first mindset; exploring opportunities for innovation and application of AI‑driven solutions to enhance content personalization and discovery, improve operational efficiency and create new fan engagement experiences that resonate with fans globally and locally. Experience leading complex projects will be highly beneficial, demonstrating aptitude for balancing personal development of others with empowerment to “get the job done”. Exceptional communication skills—both written and verbal—to succinctly and confidently interact with a wide range of stakeholders up to and including senior FIFA management. Demonstrable experience working autonomously and/or with ambiguity; with an ability to adapt swiftly to organisational change or leverage short‑term opportunities. Competencies: Confidence leading multiple projects with autonomy, often with colleagues and/or suppliers located in different territories and time zones. Passion for developing consumer experiences and thinking big picture; complemented with a demonstrable understanding of digital product development and design principles. Data‑driven with an aptitude for harnessing data, forming KPIs, and leveraging consumer insights to make informed decisions. Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and cross‑functional teams across FIFA, each with varying degrees of digital maturity and technical understanding. Willingness to travel to other FIFA offices and venues, typically in Zurich, as well as relocating to another location for a period of time, e.g. during FIFA Women’s World Cup in 2027. Technology: Strong knowledge of digital direct‑to‑consumer ecosystems, including mobile and video. Solid understanding and passion for digital innovation, including application of AI. description: Agente Educativo Junior – Rio de Janeiro/RJ ASSOCIACAO VOLUNTARIOS PARA O SERVICO INTERNACIONAL - BRASIL Vaga afirmativa para Mulheres CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO: A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana. O Projeto Light – Exposição Itinerante contempla a realização de uma exposição no Centro Cultural Light, representando a história, o impacto social e o protagonismo da Light ao longo de 120 anos na cidade do Rio de Janeiro, juntamente com o desenvolvimento de atividades imersivas com escolas, com foco em educação ambiental e no consumo consciente, eficiente e seguro de energia elétrica. Em seu segundo ano de vigência, as atividades do projeto foram ampliadas para incluir o apoio ao monitoramento dos espaços de exposição do Centro Cultural Light, contribuindo para a mídia cultural, orientação pública e apoio. Por meio deste edital, a AVSI Brasil lança a seleção de um profissional para função de Agente Educativo Jr. DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO: O Agente Educativo Jr será responsável por atuar no apoio às exposições e atividades do Centro Cultural Light, assistência e orientação ao público, apoio às atividades educativas, recreativas, imersivas e de lazer, bem como o apoio operacional às atividades programadas pela equipe educativa. Apoiar a recepção, orientação e organização do fluxo de visitantes às exposições e espaços museológicos do Centro Cultural Light; Auxiliar visitantes com necessidades especiais, garantindo acessibilidade adequada e uma experiência inclusiva; Orientar o público quanto às regras de visitação, conservação dos espaços e uso adequado dos equipamentos; Apoiar a execução de atividades recreativas, imersivas e lúdicas programadas pelo Time Educativo do Centro Cultural Educacional Light; Fornecer apoio logístico a atividades educativas, escritórios, visitas mediadas e atividades especiais; Apoiar a montagem, organização e desmontagem de materiais utilizados nas atividades; Contribuir para a manutenção do espaço expositivo, garantindo condições adequadas para a preservação de dois ambientes; Zelar pela correta utilização dos espaços de exposição e pela qualidade da experiência do visitante; Colaborar com a equipe do Time Educativo do Centro Cultural Light, garantindo apoio, segurança e organização durante esses anos; Elaborar relatórios diários das atividades realizadas. QUEM SOMOS Somos a Venancio, uma marca carioca que há mais de 46 anos coloca o cuidado no centro de tudo o que faz. title: Engenheiro Comercial
description: Atuar como responsável técnico-comercial pelo atendimento às demandas dos clientes, sendo encarregado de receber solicitações, entender necessidades técnicas, realizar visitas em campo, propor soluções elétricas, elaborar orçamentos técnicos e comerciais, além de direcionar, revisar e validar os orçamentos e projetos elétricos desenvolvidos pela equipe, assegurando a viabilidade técnica, econômica e operacional das soluções propostas. O cargo é estratégico e operacional, exigindo forte domínio técnico, visão de custos, capacidade de comunicação com clientes e integração entre orçamento, projeto e fabricação de painéis elétricos de baixa tensão. PRINCIPAIS ATRIBUIÇÕES DO CARGO Elaborar projetos técnicos de painéis elétricos de baixa tensão (e soluções associadas), e também orientar/revisar os projetos feitos pela equipe. Elaborar orçamentos técnicos e comerciais, fazendo: Levantamento de quantitativos de materiais, equipamentos e serviços; Composição de custos (diretos, indiretos, margens/BDI); Análise de prazos, riscos e viabilidade técnico- econômica. Coordenar tecnicamente a equipe de orçamento e projetos: Definindo o escopo e premissas; Revisando e validando entregas; Garantindo padrão técnico, coerência e qualidade. Atender o cliente tecnicamente: Realizando (ou validando) visitas técnicas; Entendendo a necessidade real do cliente (técnica, operacional e normativa); Traduzindo isso em escopo claro e solução técnica adequada. Propor solução técnica: Definindo a arquitetura do painel, proteções, comandos, automação; Escolhendo componentes e soluções compatíveis com custo, norma e prazo. Avaliar viabilidade e riscos: Técnicos, financeiros, produtivos e de prazo; Antecipar problemas antes de virar erro em fábrica ou campo. Responsável pelo fechamento e acompanhamento das propostas: Ciclo completo das propostas, desde a solicitação inicial até a definição da solução técnica e entrega do orçamento ao cliente e posterior follow-up, até que o ciclo do orçamento seja encerrado; Garantindo alinhamento entre escopo, orçamento, projeto e execução. Interpretar diagramas elétricos e aplicar normas técnicas e de segurança (NR-10, ABNT, IEC), assegurando a viabilidade e segurança das soluções. Sugerir melhorias em processos, padrões técnicos, soluções de engenharia e procedimentos de orçamentação. Definir prioridades e distribuir demandas entre os integrantes da equipe de orçamento e projetos, garantindo cumprimento de prazos e qualidade técnica das entregas. Formação superior em Engenharia Elétrica ou Engenharia de Controle e Automação. Registro ativo no CREA (exigência legal para a função). Conhecimento de sistemas elétricos de baixa tensão. Vivência comprovada em elaboração de orçamentos técnicos. Domínio de softwares de desenho e projeto elétrico (AutoCAD, EPLAN, CAD elétrico ou similar). Conhecimentos em automação e instrumentação (definição de sensores, atuadores, lógica de controle, PLCs, etc.). Conhecimento em normas de segurança elétrica, normas técnicas aplicáveis (NR10, SPDA, aterramento, proteção, etc.). Leitura e interpretação de desenhos mecânicos / estruturas / montagem. Familiaridade com ERP, preferencialmente Omie. Necessário experiência em projetos e orçamentos de sistemas elétricos, preferencialmente em empresas fabricantes de painéis elétricos. Experiência em vendas, fechamento de propostas e rotinas comerciais. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. The Opportunity We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges: Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency. Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems. Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets. What You’ll Do You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks: Core Responsibilities High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models. System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems. Rapid Delivery: Adopt a ‘deliver fast’ mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards. Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more): Streaming & High-Throughput Data Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time. Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings. GenAI & Autonomous Agents Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating. Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers Graph & Knowledge Engineering Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data. Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal. The Technology Stack We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track. Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes. Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data. GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs. Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search). Desired Profile Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph. Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable. You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Must Haves: 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development. Advanced English communication skills. Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms. Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI). Good to Have: Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB). GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases. Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA). Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments. Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management. Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation. description: A Climatempo é a maior empresa privada de meteorologia da América Latina. Nosso objetivo em comum é acelerar o sucesso de nossos clientes, nossos colaboradores e nosso planeta. Acreditamos na conexão entre ciência e tecnologia para tornar o futuro seguro e próspero. title: Principal Package Management Spec
description: Job Overview Principal Package Management Specialist utilizes their technical acumen, commercial acumen, management skills, and leadership skills to oversee all aspects of delivering a package from the cradle to the grave. Their core responsibility is ensuring the package is delivered on budget and on schedule while abiding by Quality, Health, Safety, Environment, and Security (QHSES) and project requirements. A successful Principal Package Management Specialist identifies risks and opportunities, sets up mitigation and captures plans accordingly. This entails developing a strategic outlook for the package and ensuring that all matters are resolved with the involvement of the right stakeholders and in a timely fashion. Principal Package Management Specialist must report status and outlook at an executive level to the Project Management team and, at times, Corporate Management. Responsibilities Deliver a package (purchase orders and/or subcontracts) on budget and schedule, and abide by QHSES and project requirements; complexity, criticality, and value of packages typically vary and are assigned and adjusted at the discretion of the function and project. Maintain a clear and thorough dialogue with the Project Management Team, and provide accurate and periodic status updates as well as both short and long-term outlooks. Identify risks and opportunities, and maintain a strategic outlook throughout the execution of the package; such discussion is to be held periodically with the Project Management team for buy-in. Maintain an accurate account of the package cost, commitments, changes, and forecast. Provide inputs and ensure alignment with Project Controls on current and forecasted cost and schedule. ROS dates to be analyzed with the schedulers to identify priorities and, if applicable, Installation Work Packages and Advance Work Packages to be set up and implemented. Track cost and schedule bid basis against actuals. Interface with all stakeholders to achieve package goals; stakeholders include but are not limited to the Supplier/Subcontractor, Engineering, Supply Chain, QHSES, Construction, Installation (if applicable), Commissioning, Joint Venture Partners, and, as needed, the client. Arrange and attend periodic status meetings with suppliers and clients as required. Manage formal correspondence with suppliers, clients, and other involved parties. Attend key meetings such as the progress meeting, kick-off meeting, PIM, and others. Oversee and enforce all day-to-day applicable processes involved and interface across various functions to identify and resolve any technical or commercial matters, and if unavoidable, then resolve any bottlenecks. Enforce the Management of Change process and Project Change Notices. Oversee the documentation process and manage priorities to ensure the most effective delivery from a cost and schedule aspect; this conversation must be coordinated between the suppliers, McDermott, and the client as applicable. Review key documents such as Technical Bid Evaluations, Commercial Bid Evaluations, Purchase Orders, and supplier data. Work with the end user to ensure alignment and expectations are met. Ensure that the prime contract flow downs are correctly administered, including variations. Oversee the planning, performance, and resource allocation of their team throughout the project. Could potentially report to the Package Manager or Senior Package Manager on a project. Develop and maintain contingency planning and lessons learned. Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent) in Engineering or Supply Chain Management (or a relevant discipline). 8-12 years of relevant experience (ideally in Engineering, Project/Package Management, Manufacturing, or similar). Technical knowledge of all phases of an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, and Installation (EPCI) project and specific knowledge in the domain of the proposed packages is preferred. Commercial knowledge of contracts, purchase orders, and relevant disciplines within the Supply Chain function, such as proposals, purchasing, expediting, logistics, and material management. Strong understanding and adherence to QHSES requirements and ability to ensure compliance. Understands the requisitioning process from the bid stage through clarifications until Purchase Order award and post-award activities such as execution, receiving, and commissioning. Proactive attitude in determining opportunities and risks, particularly those attributed to Quality, Safety, Budget, and Schedule. Characteristics of a leader that naturally relates to all members of the team, from the floor to the project team and executive management. Effective communicator with strong written, verbal, and public speaking skills. Willing to travel to various locations such as the shops, supplier offices and headquarters, job sites, labs, and other relevant locations as needed; at times, there may be a requirement for an extended deployment at a supplier’s location or the job site. PMP and/or PE is a plus. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Experiência em processos de licenciamento ambiental e/ou segurança industrial será considerada um diferencial. Conhecimentos Técnicos Desenvolvimento técnico de projetos desde a fase de pré-viabilidade e anteprojeto até o projeto básico para licenciamento. Definição do conceito de planta, elaboração de balanços de massa e energia, diagramas de processo (PFD/P&ID em nível de licenciamento), layouts e critérios de projeto. Conhecimento dos processos de tramitação administrativa, incluindo licenciamento ambiental, autorizações integradas e licenças setoriais. Gestão de interfaces de projeto (rede de gás, eletricidade, água/efluentes, acessos, servidões e terceiros). Benefícios Plano de Saúde Unimed Nacional (empresa custeia 80%). Convênio com instituições de ensino (graduação e pós-graduação). TotalPass – convênio com academias e programas de bem-estar. Vale refeição. Day Off no aniversário. Seguro de vida. title: Cientista de Dados Sênior - IA & Machine Learning | Data & AI
description: Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços. A frente de Data & AI desenvolve plataformas de dados, experimentação, machine learning, recomendação e segmentação de audiência para os produtos digitais da Globo. Essas plataformas impactam milhões de usuários por mês e suportam modelos de IA aplicados a diversos desafios, como personalização de conteúdo, publicidade contextual, predição de churn, otimização de inventário e muito mais. Buscamos um Cientista de Dados Sênior com foco em IA, que tenha experiência sólida com Machine Learning e Inteligência Artificial para nos ajudar a criar soluções inovadoras e escaláveis. Modelo de Trabalho Como será seu dia a dia: Criar e treinar modelos de IA generativa para apoiar o time de desenvolvedores na geração de código, documentação e otimização de processos; Explorar e implementar LLMs (Large Language Models) customizados para as necessidades da equipe; Desenvolver pipelines eficientes para treinamento, fine‑tuning e deployment de modelos de IA; Construir, produtizar e monitorar modelos de Machine Learning para personalização de conteúdo e engajamento dos usuários; Explorar novas arquiteturas e técnicas avançadas de aprendizado de máquina aplicadas à geração e otimização de código; Trabalhar em um time multidisciplinar, colaborando com engenheiros de machine learning, engenheiros de dados, desenvolvedores e POs para criar soluções orientadas a dados. Do que você precisa: Experiência comprovada como Cientista de Dados; Proficiência em Python e SQL para análise e modelagem de dados; Experiência em computação em nuvem (preferencialmente GCP); Conhecimento sobre melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de software e arquitetura de dados; Experiência com manipulação de grandes volumes de dados; Familiaridade com CI/CD e versionamento de código (Git); Boa capacidade de comunicação e colaboração em equipe; Ensino superior completo em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Matemática, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas. Experiência com arquiteturas de Deep Learning (Transformers, CNNs, RNNs, AutoEncoders, LLMs); Experiência com bancos de dados vetoriais; Experiência com APIs focadas em predição online; Familiaridade com ferramentas e práticas de MLOps (Docker, Kubernetes, Vertex Pipelines, Model Monitoring, Continuous Training); Inglês intermediário ou avançado. Seguindo o compromisso de contribuir para um ambiente seguro para nossas pessoas, informamos que ter o esquema completo vacinação contra a Covid‑19 é uma condição obrigatória para o trabalho na Globo, presencial ou a distância, e que o comprovante deverá ser apresentado como pré‑requisito para a contratação. #J-18808-Ljbffr

By stripping away the friction of traditional e-commerce checkouts, we are building an ecosystem where secure, instant payments are accessible across all channels—from online carts to physical stores via digital wallets. You will join the NuPay team as a technical anchor, driving the evolution of a payments stack that balances massive scale with ironclad reliability. This role is about more than just moving bits; it’s about architecting the financial infrastructure that millions of people and businesses rely on to grow, ensuring every transaction is a bridge of trust between Nubank and our partners. As a senior technical leader, you will oversee the technical direction of our payment features, navigating the complexities of authorization and settlement while mentoring the next generation of engineers. You will sit at the intersection of product innovation and platform stability, ensuring our checkout experience remains the gold standard for Latin American fintech. Responsibilities Architect scalable systems for the NuPay domain, ensuring seamless and robust integration with our global internal payment platforms. Lead technical design for core payment lifecycles—including authorization, capture, settlement, and reconciliation—while balancing performance with security. Scale the payments platform to maintain high availability during extreme traffic surges, such as Black Friday or major retail events. Partner with Product Managers to iterate on the checkout journey, optimizing for high conversion and low churn while maintaining a world‑class NPS. Define engineering standards for architecture, observability, and security, influencing multiple squads to uphold a high quality bar. Collaborate with Risk and Finance teams to engineer solutions that satisfy complex regulatory requirements without compromising the user experience. Required Qualifications Track record of technical leadership in architecting complex, distributed software environments at scale. Deep expertise in high-availability systems, with demonstrated ability to perform rigorous trade‑off analysis for long‑term scalability. Background in high‑criticality FinTech, specifically within Payments or Core Banking environments governed by strict SLAs. Evidence of delivering high‑throughput systems using modern engineering practices, including automated testing, observability, and safe rollout strategies. Experience mentoring senior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and shared ownership across organizational boundaries. Nice to Have Experience with acquiring, sub‑acquiring, or payment gateway architecture. Previous involvement with e‑commerce or marketplace platforms managing proprietary payment stacks. Location & Work Model São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte or Campinas, Brazil on a Hybrid model. Diversity & Inclusion / Equal Opportunity At Nubank, we believe that diversity is essential to building the best products and services. We are committed to creating a welcoming work environment that respects and values diversity in all its forms, and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. title: Staff Security Engineer (IAM) - BR - 2026 Brazil, Belo Horizonte; Brazil, Campinas; Brazil, Rio[...]
description: Staff Security Engineer (IAM) - BR - 2026 Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page About the Role Nubank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. This is a senior individual-contributor role with organizational-level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi-year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution. The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands‑on experience in the domain produces. Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate. What You’ll Be Responsible For Defining, communicating, and executing a multi-year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service‑to‑service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows. Translating least‑privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization‑wide program — with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization's access risk posture over time. Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework — comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes — that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits. Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence. Designing and facilitating large‑scale preparedness exercises grounded in realistic attack paths — involving engineering, operations, and executive functions — to identify genuine gaps in IAM controls, not merely satisfy a compliance requirement. Providing technical mentorship and coaching to senior engineers; lead innovative projects with universities and actively collaborate in hiring and career decisions in order to maintain a high technical standard throughout the safety organization. Serving as the technical authority in engagements with Legal, Compliance, internal audit, and external regulators on matters related to identity, authentication, and access control. We Are Looking for a Person Who Has Must-have +15 years of professional experience in security engineering, with a concentration in identity, authentication, or access management. Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi-year security programs from conception through measurable outcome — including programs that required navigating organizational obstacles, technical constraints, or material mid‑course corrections. Expert‑level knowledge of IAM and authentication protocols: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, mTLS, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). Proficiency in software engineering: ability to produce, review, and reason about production‑quality code in at least one general‑purpose programming language. Demonstrated ability to model identity‑related threat scenarios, assess attacker techniques relevant to the IAM surface, and design controls that remain effective under adversarial conditions. A demonstrable commitment to security as an organizational capability that enables business outcomes: a track record of solving real security problems, a disposition to challenge inherited security assumptions, and a clear pattern of distinguishing genuine risk reduction from security theater or responsibility transfer. Experience communicating technical risk assessments and strategic recommendations to senior non‑technical stakeholders, including executives and regulators. Nice-to-have Experience operating within a financial services institution or similarly regulated environment subject to multiple concurrent regulatory frameworks. Hands‑on experience administering or integrating with an enterprise Identity Provider at scale, particularly Okta, or Keycloak. Experience designing and enforcing security controls for third‑party, BPO, or partner environments without direct operational control of the partner's infrastructure. Experience leading organizational adoption of Zero Trust architecture, including authentication and authorization mechanisms for hybrid and multi‑cloud environments. Contributions to the broader security community — published research, conference presentations, open‑source tooling, or participation in standards bodies. Você se torna membro do “We Care Movement”, um movimento que valoriza a excelência e a inovação dentro de equipes apaixonadas. Juntos, ultrapassamos os limites da ciência para unir saúde e beleza em benefício de todos, porque cada vez que cuidamos de uma pessoa, tornamos o mundo inteiro melhor. Localidade: Rio de Janeiro, RJ Porque, assim como nós, você é movido pelo desejo de cuidar de todos, prosperar em uma empresa com propósito e se juntar a um movimento que faz a diferença! A pessoa será responsável por liderar a estratégia de vendas e trade digital para grandes players, com foco em impulsionar crescimento, visibilidade e conversão nos canais online. O que esperamos de você: Liderar o planejamento estratégico de vendas e trade para os principais clientes digitais: Amazon, Raia, Mercado Livre, Beleza na Web; Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de growth, visibilidade, conversão e share no ambiente digital; Monitorar e analisar indicadores-chave como sell out, share de gôndola digital, visibilidade, conversão e competitividade do portfólio; Definir e acompanhar KPIs críticos para performance digital, garantindo aderência às metas regionais e globais; Planejar, executar e otimizar campanhas promocionais digitais (banners, newsletters, cupons, Big Moments, Master Classes, lives); Gerenciar eficiência das iniciativas, maximizando ROI e ROAS para cada parceiro digital; Acompanhar calendário promocional dos clientes e competir estrategicamente pelos espaços de destaque; Produzir análises de performance integrando dados de e-commerce, trade e execução; Propor ações corretivas e estratégicas baseadas em dados para impulsionar vendas e eficiência comercial; Atuar em colaboração com Marketing, Vendas, Supply Chain e demais áreas internas. Um pouco do que oferecemos: Um ambiente acolhedor, com desafios e oportunidades de crescimento, que preza pelo equilíbrio entre a vida pessoal e o trabalho; Vale Refeição; Plano de Saúde e Odontológico; E muito mais. O que esperamos de você: Graduação completa; Experiência consolidada em e-commerce; Vivência em gestão comercial; Experiência em liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes. Presente em 120 países com uma equipe de mais de 10.000 colaboradores, temos orgulho de criar impacto científico e humano, hoje e amanhã! Se cuidar está no coração dos seus valores, junte‑se aos Laboratórios Pierre Fabre e torne‑se um ator essencial do “We Care Movement.” Nos Laboratórios Pierre Fabre, acreditamos que nosso maior patrimônio são as pessoas. Temos uma política global de Igualdade de Oportunidades de Emprego e não discriminaremos um candidato ou colaborador com base em raça, cor, religião, credo, origem nacional ou ascendência, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero, idade, deficiência física ou mental, status de veterano ou militar, informação genética ou qualquer outra base legalmente protegida sob leis federais, estaduais ou locais. As informações coletadas por esta candidatura destinam‑se exclusivamente a determinar a adequação ao emprego, verificar identidade e manter estatísticas de emprego sobre os candidatos. Candidatos com deficiência podem ter direito a acomodação razoável conforme a Americans with Disabilities Act e certas leis estaduais ou locais. Por favor, informe o representante de pessoal da empresa se você precisar de assistência para completar esta candidatura ou para participar do processo seletivo. Ao se candidatar a esta vaga você está ciente que será necessário o fornecimento de algumas informações pessoais a seu respeito (“dados pessoais”) à empresa para possibilitar sua identificação no processo seletivo, bem como para que a referida empresa possa entrar em contato com você. A empresa não compartilhará seus dados pessoais com terceiros sem a sua autorização, a menos que seja legalmente obrigada a fazê-lo, e seus dados pessoais permanecerão armazenados pelo período máximo de 2 anos a contar da data de fornecimento, ou da última atualização de sua candidatura à vaga. Caso você seja contratado, estes dados poderão ser armazenados por um período maior em decorrência da elaboração e execução do contrato de trabalho. Para mais informações sobre como é feito o tratamento de seus dados pessoais, bem como seus direitos enquanto titular de dados, você pode enviar uma solicitação ao Encarregado da Pierre Fabre. Estamos convencidos de que a diversidade é uma fonte de realização, equilíbrio social e complementaridade para nossos funcionários, razão pela qual nossas ofertas estão abertas a todos, sem restrições. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Digital Product Manager
description: Job Overview FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Position The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Digital Product Manager will be the driving force behind FIFA’s digital direct-to-consumer experiences for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Whilst the role will be based in Rio, the successful candidate will act as an integral member of the global Product & Design team, defining fans’ digital journey across FIFA’s owned and operated platforms, notably including FIFA.com and FIFA’s official mobile app. Reporting to Head of Brand & Marketing, the primary responsibility will involve taking the lead in evolving FIFA’s fan-facing websites and apps specifically for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This will include developing digital activations that support tournament goals and objectives, as well as delivery of commercial value for FIFA’s partners. Key Responsibilities Strategic Vision: Play a leading role in defining and developing FIFA’s digital consumer-facing proposition, specifically ensuring products and experiences reflect local fan behaviours and consumption habits, as well as aligning cultural nuances and emerging trends across Brazil and South America. Fan Engagement: Support FIFA’s audience growth goals by optimizing acquisition, engagement and retention journeys across owned platforms, as well as contributing to first-party data strategies. Value Generation: Partner closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to develop scalable digital activations and integrations that deliver measurable value to fans and partners alike. Tournament Planning & Delivery: Become an integral enabler of tournament-time digital operations, delivering high-traffic match moments, live content publishing, rapid issue resolution and cross-functional coordination during competition periods. Collaboration: Operate as an integral member of Digital Delivery, working alongside Product Managers located across Europe and acting as the department’s key representative within FIFA27. Governance & Communication: Providing clear, consistent updates to senior management and key stakeholders. Participation in cross-functional steering groups to maintain a balance between critical tournament milestones and product scope delivery. Drive Innovation: Champion a consumer-first mindset; exploring opportunities for innovation and application of AI-driven solutions to enhance content personalization and discovery, improve operational efficiency and create new fan engagement experiences that resonate with fans globally and locally. Data-driven Performance: Establish and track key performance indicators, using a blend of behavioural insights and user research to inform product development priorities, optimise product performance and exceed tournament goals and objectives. Education & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences, business management or related discipline. Relevant product development philosophies, e.g. Agile, are essential. Relevant project management qualifications, e.g. PRINCE2, highly beneficial. Work Experience 5+ years of product management experience, demonstrating end-to-end experience across the digital product lifecycle; from UX/UI design and roadmap development to rigorous testing and release management. Experience working in a direct-to-consumer business, ideally within sports, media or related industries. Experience leading complex projects will be highly beneficial, demonstrating aptitude for balancing personal development of others with empowerment to “get the job done”. Exceptional communication skills - both written and verbal – to succinctly and confidently interact with a wide range of stakeholders up to and including senior FIFA management. Demonstrable experience working autonomously and/or with ambiguity; with an ability to adapt swiftly to organisational change or leverage short-term opportunities. Competencies Confidence leading multiple projects with autonomy, often with colleagues and/or suppliers located in different territories and time zones. Passion for developing consumer experiences and thinking big picture; complemented with a demonstrable understanding of digital product development and design principles. Data-driven with an aptitude for harnessing data, forming KPIs, and leveraging consumer insights to make informed decisions. Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams across FIFA, each with varying degrees of digital maturity and technical understanding. Willingness to travel to other FIFA offices and venues, typically in Zurich, as well as relocating to another location for a period of time, e.g. during FIFA Women’s World Cup in 2027. Languages Fluent in Portuguese and English. Proficiency in another official FIFA language, such as Spanish, is a benefit. Technology Strong knowledge of digital direct-to-consumer ecosystems, including mobile and video. Solid understanding and passion for digital innovation, including application of AI. Experience with industry-standard solutions, e.g. Figma, Asana and Confluence. Requirements Right to work in Brazil. Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

THE POSITION Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, you will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN’S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the Access Management operations for all the official venues across the tournament within Brazil, in line with Access Management policies and procedures. Through close coordination with other Functional Area (FA) and venue managers, you will ensure that the operations relating to the key movements of persons holding a FIFA access device into and within their official venues meets the requirements and provide efficient, safe, and well‑planned ingress, circulation & egress. The Access Management Cluster Manager will assist the Access Management Senior Manager by supporting the Access Management Venue Managers in the preparation stages of the tournament with the possibility of then assuming the position of Access Management Venue Manager of the Rio de Janeiro Stadium during the tournament. You will ensure security personnel and other responsible staff are provided with the necessary information, training and tools to operate access control effectively at each required location. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Oversight, training and support to the Access Management Venue Managers across all official venues including Stadia, Broadcast Centre, Venue Specific Hotels, and Training Sites. Implementation and operation of Access Management policies and procedures for accredited individuals in line with the accreditation and safety and security concepts for the tournament, including access control point setup and entitlement resolution. Planning and mapping of key client group flows, vertical transportation and ingress points onto venue maps and communication of flows and ingress points to all client groups via the provision of access tours, maps and briefings. Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements. Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements. Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements on site and assist all client groups with any access related issues. Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions. Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them. YOUR PROFILE Education: Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar. If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply. Football access management knowledge. FIFA access management knowledge is a plus. Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills. Strong problem solving and analytical skills. Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues. Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people. Experience: Minimum experience of 2 years in the sport event industry, preferably within access management, accreditation, safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage. Operation and setup of complex access control systems within ticketing and/or accreditation. Wayfinding and route planning in a stadium environment. Single-sport, multi-venue event experience. Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations. Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure. Requirements: Fluent in Portuguese and English. Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Arrivals & Departures Manager
description: Arrivals & Departures Manager Department: Events & Entertainment Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION The Arrivals & Departures Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering all Arrivals & Departures operations for and during the tournament. This role ensures seamless, safe, and efficient transportation services for all FIFA client groups and spectators, guaranteeing operational readiness and flawless delivery on all airports used for the tournament. The position also liaises closely with the Airport Operators, Federal Government and Host City authorities. This role reports to the Senior Transport Manager and oversees key arrivals and departures sub-projects, including international and inter-city planning and operations, as well as aviation venue management. The Arrivals & Departures Manager collaborates closely with Airport Operators, Federal Government agencies, Host City authorities, the LFS Senior Transport Manager, the Transport Government Liaison & Integration Manager, and FIFA to define and implement an integrated concept of operations for Arrivals & Departures services. It is also the responsibility of this position to develop airport operational plans that provide essential support to both the Transport Functional Area and Event Services. The successful candidate is expected to be a proactive and resilient professional, capable of leading and managing a team while operating efficiently under pressure and delivering to strict timelines. Managing the area’s activities and resources within the approved budget is also a key component of the role. The Arrivals & Departures Manager must ensure strong integration with all other FWWC2027 functional areas present at the airport—including Workforce, Volunteers, Guest Operations & Protocol Etiquette, Team Services, and IT—to ensure alignment with established FIFA SLAs and the seamless delivery of airport operations. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Designing and implementing a suitable A&D service model that covers all tournament airports, to service all FIFA Constituent Groups (Teams, Referees, FIFA Officials, VIPs, Workforce, Dignitaries, Media, Broadcast, Commercial Affiliates) at all official point-of-entry/exit sites, based on FIFA requirements and agreed service levels including but not limited to: Final Draw Team Workshops FWWC2027 Tournament Test Events Any other official side events Designing the initial structure of International and Inter-city Arrivals and Departures / Aviation and Airport Management sub-projects including but not limited to A&D Information management, Venue planning, Constituent Group requirements, Tournament time operations. Planning and implementation of an Arrivals & Departures Plan for each FIFA Constituent Group based on FIFA requirements and service levels. Negotiating with the airport authorities and government agencies to ensure that all the structures and procedures of the airports are aligned to deliver the best operation on peak throughout the FWWC2027 operational period. Designing the concept of operations, the venue operating plan, and all relevant A&D policies and procedures. Integration with others LFS Transport workstreams functions within Event Transport for Airport pick-ups and drop-offs. Coordination with meet and greet companies regarding VIP arrivals and departures services. Contributing to the slot’s allocation plan of the HC Airports for the period of the tournament ensuring that priority is given to the FWWC2027-related aircraft movements (mainly PMA charter flights and FIFA VIP private jets). Ensuring successful integration of the FWWC2027 air traffic into the overall international airline schedule. Participate proactively in the Airport/ Mobility Working Groups and ensure (via close collaboration with HC Transport, Civil Aviation and Airport Operators and Authorities) that the air traffic match the airports and terminal capacities. Planning and development (in coordination with Airport Authorities, HC Transport, and other FWWC2027 Functional Areas (Security, Logistics, Team Services, Guest Operations, Marketing, etc.) the tournament time Operational Plan for the Airport (Airside and Landside Operations). Ensuring integration of the Airport Operational Plan with the Airport Transportation Plan, as well as correlation with all other Transport services and operations. Delivery of the final operational plan and ensure successful and smooth operations for all constituent groups. Implementing Project Management within A&D and Airport management, identifying key milestones of International and Inter-city Arrivals and Departures / Aviation and Airport Management sub-projects. Identifying and addressing key risks of International and Inter-city Arrivals and Departures / Aviation and Airport Management sub-projects. Content preparation (slides, handouts, etc.) and preparation of reports for the FWWC2027 related management meetings and working group meetings. Support recruiting, hiring each Host City A&D Manager, assigning responsibilities, and managing the Team from planning through delivery. Overall accountability for appropriate staffing levels and quality employees relating to all Airports. Ensure all Airport staff are properly trained by developing and maintaining training materials and coordinating the delivery of operational workshops and briefings, and role‑specific instructions. This HQ manager maintains consistent training standards across all Host Cities Airports. Provide regular reporting to the Transport Senior Manager, FIFA counterparts, and other key stakeholders on coordination progress, issues, and decisions. Support test events, rehearsals, and operational readiness exercises. Oversee the installation and readiness of signage, transport desk, wayfinding etc. Maintain constant live communication with the Transport Command and Control, providing real‑time updates on airport operations, incidents, delays, and any emerging issues. Ensure that all critical issue is escalated promptly, enabling rapid decision‑making and coordinated responses across all transport functions, Government agencies and Airports operators. This includes monitoring on‑ground conditions, reporting deviations from the plan, and implementing solutions to ensure smooth and uninterrupted service delivery. YOUR PROFILE Qualifications Education – Bachelor’s Degree in Transport/Logistics/Civil Engineering/Project Management/Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset. Experience Minimum of ten (10) years of event Arrivals and Departures (Airport Operations) experience in international major events in at least three (3) world‑class sport/football events. E.g. FIFA World Cup/Olympic Games. Experience should include solid experience in multiple aspects of event transport operations and project management. Minimum of five (5) years of management experience in a similar role within an organising committee leading large teams to deliver a time critical project. Proven experience of successfully managing and delivering transport projects of a similar size and scale. Proven experience of managing Airport Operations projects of a similar size and scale. Experience working with public and private sector partners in a collaborative environment and ability to build strong partnerships. Skills Advanced knowledge of administration and management principles. Advanced knowledge of teams' leadership, business process management. Advanced communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills, the ability to influence others and manage relationships. Ability to design, implement and operate a transport system in the Brazilian event environment. Advanced knowledge of transportation technical operating processes and activities. Ability to motivate others toward a common goal and manage a multidisciplinary team through conflicting priorities and continuous change requests. Ability to work and communicate in a corporate and project focused organisation. Proven project management skills within a complex project. Language skills - English language fluency both written and spoken. Strong analytical and organisation skills. Proven solution orientated decision-making skills. Ability to work under pressure to immoveable deadlines. Requirements Right to work in Brazil. Bilingual - Portuguese and English. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Banco de Talentos - Oficial Gasista|Hidráulico - H. M. Souza Aguiar
description: Na Smart Hospital, acreditamos que a diversidade nos torna mais fortes. Nossas oportunidades são abertas a todos os talentos, com foco total na inclusão de pessoa com deficiência PCD e reabilitados pelo INSS. Quem somos? Smart Hospital: Transformando a saúde com inovação. Somos líderes em construção, reforma e operação de infraestrutura hospitalar, pioneiros em modernizar hospitais por meio de parcerias público-privadas. Em parceria com o Complexo Hospitalar Souza Aguiar, o maior hospital de emergência da América Latina, estamos redefinindo os padrões de atendimento em saúde. O que buscamos? Um profissional experiente e dedicado para integrar nossa equipe como Oficial Gasista/Hidráulico. O profissional será responsável pela instalação, manutenção e reparo de tubulações de água, esgoto e, principalmente, de redes e sistemas de gás em edificações, interpretando projetos e garantindo a segurança e a conformidade técnica das instalações. Dia a dia Instalação e reparo de tubulações de água (fria e quente) e esgoto sanitário. Montagem, construção e manutenção de redes e sistemas de gás em edificações, conforme projetos. Interpretação de projetos hidráulicos, sanitários e de gás para a correta implantação dos sistemas. Realização de reparos em canos, vazamentos, sistemas hidráulicos e desobstrução de tubulações e ralos. Montagem, instalação e manutenção de aquecedores, aparelhos a gás e outros equipamentos. Utilização de técnicas e equipamentos especializados para identificar e reparar vazamentos de gás, garantindo a segurança. Execução de testes para verificar a segurança, a ausência de vazamentos e a eficiência das instalações de gás e hidráulicas. Realização de manutenção de primeiro nível em máquinas e equipamentos utilizados durante os serviços. Preparação e organização do local de trabalho, garantindo o cumprimento de procedimentos e normas regulamentadoras de saúde, segurança no trabalho e meio ambiente. Local de atuação: Complexo Hospitalar Municipal Souza Aguiar | Endereço: Praça da República, 111, Centro, Rio de Janeiro Horário: Plantonista 12x36 Diurno Ímpar - Horário fixo 7h às 19h. Requisitos Experiência comprovada como Bombeiro Hidráulico/Encanador. Conhecimento e experiência na instalação e manutenção de sistemas de gás (Gasista). Curso de Encanador e Bombeiro Hidráulico (ou formação técnica equivalente). Curso de Gasista. Habilidade na leitura e interpretação de projetos hidráulicos e de sistemas de gás. Conhecimento das normas técnicas e regulamentações aplicáveis à instalações hidráulicas, sanitárias e de gás. Comprometimento com a segurança e com as normas regulamentadoras (NRs). O Que Vamos Amar Se Você Tiver Proatividade e capacidade de solucionar problemas de forma autônoma. Experiência em soldagem (cobre, aço). Certificações adicionais na área de segurança ou manutenção de equipamentos. Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e comunicar-se de forma clara. Benefícios Mobilidade: Cartão Swile com VT (combo mobilidade) para você escolher a melhor forma de chegar ao trabalho. Alimentação: VA/VR (R$ 25,00/dia) com a flexibilidade de um cartão de crédito, para você escolher onde e como se alimentar. Saúde: Plano de saúde, programa Vittude de saúde mental, plano odontológico e Totalpass para cuidar do seu bem-estar físico e mental. Finanças: Descontos diferenciados em folha de pagamento. Day off no aniversário: Proporcionando um dia de descanso para comemorar seu aniversário. Convênio com SESC: Oferece acesso a diversas atividades de lazer e cultura, promovendo a qualidade de vida pra você e sua família. Seguro de vida: Garante a segurança financeira da sua família em caso de imprevistos, proporcionando tranquilidade e proteção. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Profissional Program Planning

Estabelecer uma rotina consistente de reportes, incluindo reuniões semanais, quinzenais ou mensais, conforme necessário. Preparar consolidações e resumos do programa para a liderança e executivos. Garantir que os dados dos projetos sejam precisos, atualizados e acionáveis. Manter visibilidade sobre o desempenho financeiro do programa, incluindo orçamento, realizado, forecast, margem, burn rate e alocação de custos. Consolidar informações financeiras de múltiplos projetos em uma visão única do programa. Identificar lacunas relacionadas ao acompanhamento orçamentário, alocação de recursos, utilização de centros de custo, change orders e previsões financeiras. Sinalizar inconsistências para os gerentes de projeto e para a liderança do programa, permitindo ações corretivas. Apoiar os gerentes de projeto com recomendações quando houver desvios financeiros ou de entrega. Monitorar áreas compartilhadas entre projetos, incluindo recursos comuns, dependências cruzadas e custos não atribuídos. Gestão de Performance da Execução e Riscos Monitorar cronogramas, custos, mudanças de escopo, riscos, problemas, dependências e saúde das entregas em todo o programa. Conduzir reuniões recorrentes de revisão com os gerentes de projeto. Questionar reportes incompletos, pouco claros ou quando o desempenho estiver abaixo do esperado. Identificar riscos antecipadamente e escalá-los com recomendações objetivas. Partner closely with colleagues across sectors, countries, and analytical groups to advance the One CIPF approach and strengthen Fitch’s market presence across Latin America. Strong knowledge of the Energy, Power & Utilities sectors, ideally including exposure to regulated utilities, power generation, transmission, renewables, and/or midstream or energy infrastructure assets. Demonstrated experience managing people and/or leading teams in an analytical environment. Solid understanding of financial statement analysis, credit fundamentals, and debt capital structures. Proven ability to assess and explain analytically complex topics with sound judgment and intellectual rigor. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Fluency in English and Portuguese required; Spanish strongly preferred. Bachelor’s degree required; MBA, master’s degree, CFA, CPA, or other advanced professional qualification preferred. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build credibility with internal and external stakeholders. A strong professional background in capital markets and/or credit analysis, supported by well-developed financial statement analysis and credit assessment skills. Demonstrated interest in deepening exposure to and understanding of the debt capital markets, particularly as they relate to Latin American issuers and infrastructure assets. A clear pattern of leadership, with the ability to proactively and effectively engage with a wide range of stakeholders, both internally and externally. Presence, judgment, and communication skills to represent Fitch credibly with issuer management teams, investors, bankers, and market participants. A collaborative mindset and a strong commitment to mentoring junior analysts and contributing to the development of the broader team. #J-18808-Ljbffr

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Manutenção
description: ## Pessoa Coordenadora de ManutençãoApplylocations: Brazil - Usine Arealtime type: Full timeposted on: Posted Yesterdayjob requisition id: JR # ****Who we are ?****BE PART OF A COMPANY FOCUSED ON HEALTH AND WELL-BEINGOur reason for beingEvery time we innovate to help each person live better...* Every time we give back to nature for her treasures...* Each time we share the fruit of our efforts with those and those working and living beside us...* Each time the Pierre Fabre Foundation improves access to care for those most in need...* Every time we take care of a single person, we make the whole world better. In Brazil, Pierre Fabre has a focus on dermocosmetics.Our numbers:* 3 brands of dermoscosmetics (Avène, Darrow and Ducray)* + 350 employees in Brazil and more than 10,000 worldwide.A unique business modelThe Pierre Fabre Group has a unique business structure, since 86% of its shares belong to the Pierre Fabre Foundation, which has the mission of providing quality health and medicines to the most vulnerable people in the Southern Hemisphere of the world.# ****Your mission****Somos os Laboratórios Pierre Fabre, líder global que combina expertise farmacêutica com dermocosméticos para apoiar consumidores e pacientes em todas as etapas de sua jornada de cuidados.Nosso portfólio inclui várias franquias médicas e marcas internacionais como Eau Thermale Avène, Ducray, Darrow, A‐Derma, Klorane e René Furterer.Ao se juntar a nós, você se torna parte de uma empresa com propósito, onde a dimensão humana é essencial. Você se torna membro do “We Care Movement”, um movimento que valoriza a excelência e a inovação dentro de equipes apaixonadas.Juntos, ultrapassamos os limites da ciência para unir saúde e beleza em benefício de todos, porque cada vez que cuidamos de uma pessoa, tornamos o mundo inteiro melhor.**Vaga**: Pessoa Coordenadora de Manutenção**Localidade:** Areal, RJPorque, se assim como nós, você é movido pelo desejo de cuidar de todos, prosperar em uma empresa com propósito e se juntar a um movimento que faz a diferença!Estamos em busca de um gestão estratégica e operacional da manutenção industrial, atuando no planejamento e execução de atividades preventivas, preditivas e corretivas para garantir disponibilidade e confiabilidade dos equipamentos.**A sua missão:*** Gerenciar o planejamento e a execução da manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva dos equipamentos e instalações industriais;* Gerenciar as atividades da equipe de mantenedores visando maximizar a disponibilidade dos equipamentos e instalações industriais através da melhoria contínua dos processos;* Gerenciar a gestão das atividades de manutenção, através de softwares e planilhas especificas;* mantenedores de manutenção;* Implantar as mudanças necessárias com solução para os problemas e tomada de decisão adequada;* Suporte na gestão do budget anual de despesas a através do desenvolvimento de fornecedores, controle de estoques de manutenção, redução de perdas, controle de recursos energéticos e telefonia;* Suporte na gestão de projetos de investimentos nas fases de definição de escopo, planejamento, execução, controle e avaliação dos resultados;* Definir e controlar metas e indicadores de desempenho da manutenção;* Elaborar documentação técnica, analisar relatórios, planejar intervenções, mapear riscos e recomendar reparo ou substituição dos equipamentos e instalações;* Assegurar a adoção de medidas corretivas para as situações de risco grave e iminente reportada pelos seus liderados, quando do uso do direito de recusa, previamente ao retorno da atividade.**Um pouco do que oferecemos:*** Vale-Transporte;* Refeição no local;* Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;* Wellhub;* E muito mais!# ****Who you are ?****#**O que esperamos de você:*** Escolaridade: Curso Superior Completo em Engenharia (Preferencialmente Elétrica)* Inglês nível intermediário;* Carteira de motorista.Presente em 120 países com uma equipe de mais de 10.000 colaboradores, temos orgulho de criar impacto científico e humano, hoje e amanhã! description: Ouvir, criar e inspirar a transformação digital dos nossos clientes é o que nos motiva. title: Facility Engineer
description: Job Family: Operations and Technical Management Location: Santos, BR, Rio de Janeiro, BR, Purpose As a Facility Engineer, you are responsible for monitoring and ensuring the production of the units, with a focus on the monitoring of all topside equipment. This role also includes troubleshooting and conducting incident analysis for any issues that arise in the units. Additionally, you ensure that all processes and facilities adhere to company and industry standards, safety regulations, and environmental guidelines, while optimizing performance, reliability, and cost‑effectiveness. Responsibilities Ensure that the unit operates within design conditions, maintaining optimal performance and safety. Ensure all facilities and processes adhere to industry safety standards, environmental regulations, and company policies. Conduct regular safety audits, hazard assessments, and risk analyses, implementing corrective actions as needed to mitigate risks. Conduct and participate actively in investigations of incidents related to production loss and process safety, ensuring thorough analysis and follow‑up actions. Oversee the day‑to‑day operation of production facilities, ensuring optimal performance and reliability. Implement and maintain best practices in process management, maintenance, and operational procedures to minimize downtime and reduce operational costs. Provide technical support to offshore operations, including process monitoring using tools like PI, SEEQ, and daily reports. Lead and coordinate facility‑related projects from conceptualization to execution, ensuring timely delivery within budget. Assist in planning, organizing, and coordinating planned interventions in process equipment such as CO2 membranes, SRP membranes, mol sieves, and guard filters. Provide technical recommendations to offshore teams for process optimization, improvements, and best practices. Conduct technical meetings with offshore teams to address process deviations and implement coordinated actions. Participate in and support risk assessments (HAZOP, HAZID, ORA, TRA, SIL) and review action plans. Execute technical internal audits offshore and support audits such as SGSO, ANP, CONAMA, and PAG. Share lessons learned and disseminate technical best practices across the organization. Support offshore teams in ramp‑up/down planning and equipment preservation for shutdowns (SD). Define and execute a 3‑Year Plan (3YP) related to preventive facilities scope, supporting the P &F Lead and Technical Specialists in the 3YP budget exercise. Education Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline. Experience Chemical industry acting as process or production engineer. Project business focussed in process engineering. Oil and gas experience (desired). Experience in industry. Functional Competencies Process – Process System Engineering Integrity and Reliability Remote Surveillance and Monitoring – Learning from events Reliability, Operability and Safety – Incident Management Process – Process Equipment and Internals Design Troubleshooting – ICSS Process Control – Analysis and Planning Equal Employment Opportunity SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and affirmative action employer. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Descrição da vaga O CEL Intercultural School tem como missão proporcionar uma educação global de excelência, norteada por valores humanos, contribuindo para formar cidadãos íntegros e capazes de realizar as suas potencialidades. Nosso principal objetivo é a formação integral dos nossos alunos, pois, além de garantir o ensino de excelência, temos também o compromisso de formar cidadãos com pensamento crítico, princípios éticos, capazes de desenvolver e repensar a realidade de hoje. Estamos em busca de um(a) pedagogo(a) comunicativo(a), carismático(a) e com forte perfil relacional, que tenha afinidade com a área comercial e seja capaz de representar com excelência a proposta pedagógica da escola. Esse(a) profissional será um dos primeiros pontos de contato entre muitas famílias e a nossa instituição, atuando na condução de apresentações institucionais, visitas guiadas e no acompanhamento do processo de ingresso de novos alunos e responsáveis. Também caberá a essa pessoa apoiar as equipes pedagógica e comercial no desenvolvimento e execução das estratégias de retenção e fidelização de alunos. Responsabilidades e atribuições Visitas pedagógicas: atender todas as famílias candidatas, apresentando a proposta educacional com clareza, empatia e embasamento técnico. Rematrícula e fidelização: acompanhar processos de renovação, identificando e contatando famílias com risco de evasão. Atendimento inicial: atuar como ponto de escuta pedagógica para dúvidas, expectativas e necessidades específicas de famílias e alunos recém-chegados. Onboarding escolar: planejar e executar o processo de recepção e acompanhamento dos novos alunos nas primeiras semanas de aula em interlocução com os coordenadores de segmento e orientadoras educacionais. Interlocução com a coordenação: encaminhar situações pedagógicas com clareza e registro para trazer devolutivas relevantes do relacionamento com famílias, contribuindo para ações de melhoria contínua e estratégias de retenção. Gestão de dados: alimentar o sistema de CRM com informações pedagógicas relevantes para o histórico do aluno e o acompanhamento institucional. Atingimento de Metas de nº de alunos e faturamento: perseguir o número de alunos para atingimento das metas de admissão e renovação de acordo com o orientado pela instituição. Requisitos e qualificações Formação obrigatória: Licenciatura ou pedagogia. Desejável: Especialização em Psicopedagogia, Gestão Educacional, Mediação Escolar ou áreas correlatas e experiência mínima de 2. Competências importantes: Escuta qualificada e empatia; Capacidade de explicar processos pedagógicos com clareza e segurança; Organização administrativa e domínio de sistemas de acompanhamento escolar (CRM, matrícula, etc.); Boa interlocução com setores comerciais e administrativos, sem perder a centralidade do projeto educativo. title: Assistente de Loja - Shopping Nova América
description: Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes. Se você é uma pessoa organizada, tem senso de espaço e um bom olhar para entender. Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa: Dar aquele talento na loja e mantê-la sempre preparada para os nossos clientes, na parte de vestuário e acessórios. Ter agilidade e dinamismo para atuar nos diferentes setores da loja. Pra jogar bonito, você precisa ter: Ensino Médio completo Boa comunicação Vontade de aprender e sede de crescimento as necessidades da loja, essa posição é para você. Você vai garantir que tudo esteja impecável, do atendimento ao estoque, deixando nossos clientes super satisfeitos. A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas 230 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil. Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo! O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo . Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões . Nós somos a Centauro, uma empresa do Grupo SBF. Queremos ser reconhecidos na sociedade como a marca que movimenta o mercado esportivo para um novo patamar, contribuindo com o aumento da atividade física no Brasil. Estamos presentes em 26 estados, com 226 lojas próprias espalhadas pelo Brasil. Somos convictos, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas pela força da nossa essência. Somos fazedores, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas com ações práticas. Somos saudavelmente inconformados, acreditamos em mobilizar pessoas a fazerem mais e melhor. Somos criadores, acreditamos que sendo curiosos e tendo sede pelo novo, vamos criar o que ainda não foi feito. #J-18808-Ljbffr

customer behavior data to uncover drivers of reactivation, lead conversion, and churn recovery Build and manage the experimentation roadmap across messaging, incentives, audiences, channel mix, and timing Launch and scale lifecycle campaigns from ideation through rollout using Braze and in‑house tools Design, run, and analyze A/B tests that improve KPIs such as reactivation rate, lead‑to‑activation rate, and engagement Map consumer flows, identify friction points, and recommend scalable solutions or short‑term testing opportunities – define lifecycle KPIs, maintain reporting, and share clear insights, forecasts, variance explanations, and recommendations with stakeholders Partner with Creative, Product, Analytics, and FP&A to align lifecycle priorities and drive high‑impact growth initiatives Experience You Bring 3+ years of experience in growth marketing, lifecycle or CRM marketing, consulting, analytics, or a data‑driven marketing role Hands‑on experience with user acquisition or growth marketing, including lead generation, conversion, and paid or owned acquisition channels Experience owning lifecycle programs from strategy through execution, measurement, and optimization Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights, testing plans, and business recommendations Experience designing testing strategies, running A/B tests, and using results to improve campaign performance Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs and campaigns with minimal oversight Strong Excel skills and working knowledge of basic SQL for self‑serve data pulls Familiarity with Braze or a comparable email or lifecycle service provider, and experience using project management software such as Asana or JIRA The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Strong stakeholder‑management skills , including experience working with senior product and business leaders, negotiating priorities and driving alignment. description: Purpose To ensure that the offshore subsea equipment spread is operated and maintained in an efficient, organised, and controlled manner in accordance with manufacturer operating manuals and project procedures. Escalate system downtime or reduced functionality to vessel leadership and onshore management where required. Assist with reporting, documentation, and technical returns for subsea systems.
